findings: HEW: complete held EO12212 (45 FR29557, PDF11) makes the Department of Education Organization Act effective May4,1980. A held official USC50 extract editorial note identifies HEW Secretary redesignation to HHS via20USC3508(b). These distinguish a name/successor change from an automatic original-command cessation. I did not locate/read the actual20USC3508 or P.L.96-88 reorganization/savings text in this bounded comparison, and assign no original seat end.

Community Services Administration: held 1989 OFR codification EO12160 extract editorial note reports abolition through repeal of the Economic Opportunity Act by P.L.97-35 (95Stat519,42USC2941), and creation of the Office of Community Services in HHS (95Stat516,42USC9905). This is a concrete contrary lead for EO12075 roster(l), but not a read of the abolishing statute, effective date, or savings/transfer clauses. It warrants narrow roster source review before affirming that every original membership directive continued unchanged until1982. I assign no earlier date from the editorial note.

No new substantive agency-abolition determination is certified. The already frozen REJECT stands independently on the omitted EO12149/EO12314 branch. A corrected claim should explicitly distinguish renaming, succession, transfer, abolition and Council-wide termination instead of treating roster wording as necessarily unchanged.
